encodingComparison.note: Predates benchmark-required gzip, repeated-header fix, delimiter caching and JSON codepage caching.

phaseDiagnostic.note: Separate diagnostic before the final native delimiter/repeated-header build; direct rows, no dataset processing.

actualFWRestClient.includes: gzip/identity, seven-byte transfer chunks, CRC failure/recovery, NUL, strict gzip and empty406

finalChecks.headerInvariant: One worker-local cHeaderEnd initialization; reused in read loop/trace and passed to ParseRequestHeader; verified managed preparation and real native regression.

encodingComparison.timingScope: Full M08 client traversal and value validation; construction/warmup excluded.

jsonCodepageComparison.conclusion: Exact output and SET behavior preserved. Opposite timing directions and high batch CV do not establish a reliable speedup; keep invariant lookup removal without HTTP performance claim.

logReconstruction: Remove only the exact interleaved [INFO ][SERVER] TOTVS Application Server Initializing... marker and actual CR/LF to recover complete JSON records; then verify counts, success and aggregates. Samples/statistics unchanged. Corrected profile parser validated on the completed raw run.
limitations: Dated phases have different native binary/RPO identities; historical tmp paths are not reproduction prerequisites.
Responses materialized; request gzip, streaming, SQL binding and MEMIO caching not implemented.
No Linux/direct TLS, per-stage CPU/memory, production capacity, cold-cache or general speedup acceptance.
FWRest phase includes SQL, encoding and network; diagnostic direct validation does not measure dataset overhead.
Private configurations, credentials, licensed SDK/RPO contents and raw logs are not included.

userProvidedBenchmarks.method: Recompute measured samples; median, P95 nearest rank, population SD; check row/page/call totals. Companion HTML is never read or executed.
